component.name: itele
component.summary: Watch live TV, movies and series from your IPTV providers

description.p: itele is a native IPTV player with Xtream Codes support. Sign in to one provider or several, browse their channels, movies and series side by side, read the guide, search it all, and watch, in one window that starts fast and stays light.

ul.li: Home opens on the channel you watched last, with what you left unfinished
Live TV with groups, logos and what is on now and next
Favorites across providers, in your order
A TV guide grid, search across everything, and catch-up
Movies and series with plot, cast, seasons and resume
Audio and subtitle menus, and hardware decoding through libmpv

description.p: Passwords stay in the system keychain. itele brings no channels of its own: it plays what your provider offers.
